notes.title: Dev blog 1.1: Progress update
notes.notes:
Greetings, adventurers!
It’s been a while since our last update. Over the past six months, we’ve been intensively reworking a few of our key systems, including our procedural world generation algorithm, to fix some issues discovered during internal gameplay tests. We’re not quite ready to show the new system in action just yet, but we’re making great progress and can’t wait to share more with you soon.

Stay tuned, adventurers!
